title: Arbitrary high order splitting methods for linear Schr{ö}dinger equations with non-trivial compatibility conditions
summary: Splitting methods are a natural choice for the numerical time integration of partial differential equations, and arbitrary high order splitting schemes exist for Schr{ö}dinger equations with periodic boundary conditions. However, in the presence of non-periodic boundary conditions, we show that they suffer in general from an order reduction, even for smooth initial conditions. The reason for such order reduction phenomena are so-called compatibility conditions, which are not preserved by classical splitting schemes.
